text:
tim: opening a concise tracker for streaming postmortem follow-ups. issue recurs: partial responses + reconnect storms on eu-west under burst load. goal: assign owners, short ETAs, weekly pulse.

maria: i'll own reconnect sticky-state investigation and a short-term server mitigant (backpressure + jittered reconnect). ETA 2026-04-02. HF-4401.

alex: i'll own KV eviction / duplicate-ACK dedup and small-batch fallback. plan: 200ms grace before eviction + unit tests. ETA 2026-04-09. HF-4402.

sre-lead: will deploy a canary rate-shed in eu-west to cap concurrent streaming per node and apply 1-3s jittered client backoff. Canary: 2026-03-30 -> 2026-03-31. HF-4403.

oncall-bot: Reminder: add HF IDs to updates. Weekly auto-check in 7 days.

maria: repro snippet shows duplicate partial ACK causing eviction: ```2026-03-19T05:12:03Z STREAM node=gs-04 event=partial_ack seq=211 session=abc123
2026-03-19T05:12:03Z STREAM node=gs-04 event=partial_ack seq=211 session=abc123
2026-03-19T05:12:03Z KVCACHE node=gs-04 action=evict session=abc123 reason=dup_ack``` Suggest dedup window 200-250ms.

alex: added unit test for dup ACK and 200ms grace. bench (synthetic) shows eviction down ~80%. PR link will be posted under HF-4402.

tim: also run a 90-day query by region/model/seq-len to confirm recurrence buckets. alex can you paste results?

alex: quick summary: spikes in eu-west and us-east, 3x higher for requests >2048 tokens, concentrated on legacy model variants. full table in HF-4402 comment.

sre-lead: monitoring: charting partial-response-rate and token-drop-rate by region/model. Rollback rule: auto-rollback if token-drop-rate +0.6% over baseline for 3 consecutive 10m windows.

ton: agreed. we'll run 15-min sync tomorrow and use this thread as primary tracker. start updates with HF number.
